goal: Code-generated Li River karst, quiet reflected water, dawn mist, 45-second flight, live controls, parameter panel, UI hide and 1080p60 offline export; integrated into the existing project page.
sceneAssetsPolicy: No external models, images, textures or HDR. In-memory procedural geometry, noise, render targets and generated light/occlusion sampling are allowed. Libraries are local pinned code.
referencePolicy: Photographs are observation references only; no reference photograph is rendered, downloaded as a scene asset or used as a background.
acceptance: Actual images judged separately from function, whole flight, frame-rate measurement, output WebM decoding, narrow layouts and parent-page lifecycle.
